Name: Animated Junimo Sprinklers
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aHq0aHA.png[/img]﻿
﻿H[size=3]ere is another mod I made so people can fill their farms with Junimos, it can be used on sprinklers, there is 10 colors and 3 animation options (wave hello, dance and bounce), I want to make more Junimo mods in the future, there is never enough Junimo![/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hNORhek.png[/img]﻿
[center][size=3][url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/author/concernedape/]ConcernedApe[/url]﻿ for creating [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Junimos]Junimos[/url]﻿, cutest apples ever <3[/size][/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/n2YpLy5.png[/img]﻿
[center][size=3][b]1[/b]. Download this mod and Alternative Textures

[b]2[/b]. Drop everything in the mods folder

[b]3[/b]. Buy the paint bucket from Robin and use it on any sprinkler

[b]4[/b].  Enjoy!
